results.output: World/economy: PASS — overflow, regeneration, daily boundaries, rollback, actual spend, task reachability/reroll, permanent wardrobe, checks, 2d/3d lifecycle, relationships and season including delayed paid orders.
Serverless: PASS — real SQL migration, CAS, ownership, complete bundle, paid season, replay, rollback, RLS, auth/CORS, signed receipts, immutable orders; web checkout disabled.
Cloud client: PASS — serialized signed grants, cloud-before-consume, replay, local/server failure recovery, stale-device conflict, stable fingerprints, no production fake payments.
World fields: PASS — 960 seeded boards, 32 story stops; average generation attempts 1.64, max 16. No claim about completion probability.
Telemetry: PASS — cohorts, deduplication, mature retention denominators, separate level modes, duration and gross/refund energy.
Ad callbacks: PASS — rapid requests, repeated reward/close/error, and offline completion are idempotent.
Journey events: PASS (100 distinct levels, 25-stop maps, story pacing, placement, save/reload and completion at level 25)
Animal showcase generation: PASS (35 cells, all 12 animals, restarts and regular-board retries)
Mushroom harvest: quick fade, raised anchoring, scaled tile, pooling, reuse and teardown passed.
Ladybug movement: synchronized swaps, permanent first-entry removal, shared-cell reservations, anchored escapes, water transport and collected guards passed.
Hero abilities: three-slot roster, gross energy, thresholds/overflow, pending summons, round-robin, ranked sequential owl reveals, landing guard and exit cleanup passed.

Kitten discovery: level-14 route, raised position, one-shot bounce and restored scale passed.
House discovery: last mushroom in 19 reveal orders, diary size, first/replacement dialogue readiness, replay and stale callbacks passed.
Item shadows: ground anchoring, spread, altitude fade, tile scaling, texture reuse and cleanup passed.
Forest presentation: persistent transition handoff, neighbor-triggered snail, full turn frames and hex waves passed.
PASS level artwork: continuous proportional scenes, viewport reserve, graded haze, matching scroll masks, cleanup and stable unnumbered-scenery opacity.
PASS settings: 80 rapid inputs, fixed gear, separate action targets, reuse, blocker cleanup, single support handoff.

PASS UI goals: 100 repeated refreshes, one check, positive count restored, check reused.
PASS goal geometry: 1–3 digit counts, trimmed artwork, shared center and compact gap.
PASS shop navigation: 80 actual tab callbacks, Heroes → Items, one active section, shop stays open.
PASS home progress: empty/partial/full inner bounds, clamping, zero totals, animated completion, one reward and chapter handoff, tween cleanup.
PASS diary: viewport fit and animated side margins, first/last boundaries, closed state, 100 rapid page inputs and completed turns.
Snail sparks: bounded 28-sprite pool, two rising stair paths, varied trajectories, fade and cleanup passed.
PASS: consecutive wins, no false no-grey reward, duplicate guard, 1/12/180 curved flights, camera/scale, moving target, counter, cleanup, bounded particles.
RGB tint interpolation: PASS (3003 intermediate colors, no ARGB or channel wrap)
